label: ElevenLabs Transcribe File
description: Speech-to-text for a stored audio file (Scribe): a voice note, a recording, a call. Audio file in, the transcript out as text, with the language the model heard. For a live audio stream use ElevenLabsTranscribe instead.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node): whose key the call spends.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The recording to transcribe (any common audio format; a WhatsApp voice note is Ogg Opus).

inputs.name: language
inputs.label: Language
inputs.description: ISO language code of the audio (en, fr, ...). Empty lets the model detect it.

outputs.name: language
outputs.description: The language the model heard (ISO code).
